component.name: M.G Linux Toolbox
component.summary: Understand and manage supported Linux system features
Comprendi e gestisci le funzioni Linux supportate

description.p: M.G Linux Toolbox presents supported Linux system features in a clear GTK4 and Libadwaita interface.
M.G Linux Toolbox presenta le funzioni Linux supportate in un'interfaccia chiara basata su GTK4 e Libadwaita.

Adds ClamAV antivirus management (install from official repositories, signature updates, on-demand file/folder scanning, scan-service start/stop and uninstall). Splits "Network & Security" into "Network & Devices" and "Security", moving Firewall, SSH and ClamAV into a reorganized Security page. Adds a "Help & Support" page. Various interface consistency fixes across the Kernel, Audio, Virtualization, Energy and Services pages.
Fixes managed updates when the temporary download directory and the managed installation are on different filesystems.
Adds startup confirmation and verified rollback to managed one-click updates, and makes portable-to-managed installation transactional.

Fixes privileged operations when running as AppImage via a stable root-owned helper, rewrites the VFIO wizard with safe per-group selection, and adds full one-click updates with checksum verification, backup and rollback.
Adds corrected live PSI status, disk activity monitoring and the read-only Gaming Pack V1 preview.
